blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Democrat Gina Hinojosa unseated incumbent Texas Governor Greg Abbott in Tuesday’s US midterms elections, media projections showed, in a stunning triumph for her party in the Lone Star State. Hinojosa, a 52-year-old attorney and state lawmaker, is part of a new generation of Democrats who are seeking to attract independents and voters disillusioned by President Donald Trump’s unpopular war in the Middle East and skyrocketing prices for gas and everyday goods. CNN and NBC News called the race in Hinojosa’s favor. READ: Democrats win US House in growing midterms wave against Trump In a statement on X Tuesday night, […]...
